task.title: Desk swipe observes its preconditions
task.acceptance_criteria: e2e swipe() waits for observable gesture state and attaches a bounded event trace to a failing assertion; the wide-desk control at e2e/desk.test.ts:597 passes repeatedly against a production build.

contract.problem: CI run 40310239199 failed e2e/desk.test.ts:597 'the swipe dragged music: 0.3 is not 0.425': music kept its default x, so the raw-CDP touch drag was never committed. The same test passed on identical sources in four other runs, so it is a timing flake that blocks deploys. pm-258's fix_plan_run-8849.md prescribes the repair; the swipe helper at e2e/desk.test.ts:218 is still the unobserved original.
action_items: first check git log for e2e/desk.test.ts: if pm-258/t-1564 already landed a swipe() with observed preconditions, verify it against the list below, add what is missing and stop
in e2e/desk.test.ts swipe() scroll the tape into view, wait for its box to be stable across two animation frames, and assert the element at that point is the tape
after the first touchMove past 6 px wait for [data-dragging] on the item; after touchEnd wait for it to clear; use waiting conditions, not a fixed sleep

add scripts/e2e-gesture-trace.ts (pure, with scripts/e2e-gesture-trace.test.ts under node --test) that keeps a bounded (max 40) list of pointerdown/pointermove/pointerup/pointercancel records and formats them; use it so the trace is in the assertion message of the wide-desk control at :597 and the narrow/tablet no-drag checks
keep the expected 120 px drop and the narrow/tablet no-drag assertions; do not quarantine unless the trace shows an environmental cause, and say so in the commit

only if the trace shows a valid gesture reaching ink-desk.tsx and being lost, repair the smallest responsible branch of app/(site)/(app)/desk/_components/ink-desk.tsx:511-593 with a failing-before/passing-after regression
run the e2e suite 3 times against a production build (scripts/e2e-local.sh needs docker; otherwise CI's service Postgres) and record pass counts in the commit
